lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੪॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bhaai bhagat nihaal naanak sadaa sadaa kurabaan ||2||4||49||
lines.translation: In the Fear of God and loving devotion, Nanak is exalted and enraptured, forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||4||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਰਚ ਚਰਚ ਚਰਚਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karat karat charach charach characharee ||
lines.translation: The debaters debate and argue their arguments.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਭੇਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਧਰਤ ਧਰਤ ਧਰਚਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog dhiaan bhekh giaan phirat phirat dharat dharat dharacharee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Yogis and meditators, religious and spiritual teachers roam and ramble, wandering endlessly all over the earth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰ ਅਹੰ ਅਹੈ ਅਵਰ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਬਵਰਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n) aha(n) ahai avar mooR mooR mooR bavaraee ||
lines.translation: They are egotistical, self-centered and conceited, foolish, stupid, idiotic and insane.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲ ਹਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jat jaat jaat jaat sadaa sadaa sadaa sadaa kaal haee ||1||
lines.translation: Wherever they go and wander, death is always with them, forever and ever and ever and ever. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan maan maan tiaag mirat mirat nikat nikat sadaa haee ||
lines.translation: Give up your pride and stubborn self-conceit; death, yes, death, is always close and near at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਭਾਜੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੂੜ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਭਜਨ ਭਜਨ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੫੦॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
lines.transliteration: har hare hare bhaaj kahat naanak sunahu re mooR bin bhajan bhajan bhajan ahilaa janam gaee ||2||5||50||12||62||
lines.translation: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Har, Haray, Haray. Says Nanak, listen you fool: without vibrating, and meditating, and dwelling on Him, your life is uselessly wasting away. ||2||5||50||12||62||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa asatapadeeaa mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam sukh paavaigo ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu japai tivai sukh paavai satigur sev samaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The more you chant and meditate, the more you will be at peace; serve the True Guru, and merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਲੋਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa(n) kee khin khin lochaa naam japat sukh paavaigo ||
lines.translation: Each and every instant, the humble devotees long for Him; chanting the Naam, they find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: an ras saad gae sabh neekar bin naavai kichh na sukhaavaigo ||1||
lines.translation: The taste of other pleasures is totally eradicated; nothing pleases them, except the Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਠੇ ਬਚਨ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat har har meethaa laagaa gur meethe bachan kadhaavaigo ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord seems sweet to them; the Guru inspires them to speak sweet words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur baanee purakh purakhotam baanee siu chit laavaigo ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the True Guru's Bani, the Primal Lord God is revealed; so focus your consciousness on His Bani. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurabaanee sunat meraa man draviaa man bheenaa nij ghar aavaigo ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, my mind has been softened and saturated with it; my mind has returned to its own home deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨੀ ਬਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਨੀਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tah anahat dhunee baajahi nit baaje neejhar dhaar chuaavaigo ||3||
lines.translation: The Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds there continuously; the stream of nectar trickles down constantly. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲ ਤਿਲ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ik til til gaavai man guramat naam samaavaigo ||
lines.translation: Singing the Name of the One Lord each and every instant, and following the Guru's Teachings, the mind is absorbed in the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naam sunai naamo man bhaavai naame hee tripataavaigo ||4||
lines.translation: Listening to the Naam, the mind is pleased with the Naam, and satisfied with the Naam. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਨਿਕ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਗਨਾ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਨਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kanik kanik pahire bahu ka(n)ganaa kaapar bhaa(n)t banaavaigo ||
lines.translation: People wear lots of bracelets, glittering with gold; they wear all sorts of fine clothes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਫੀਕ ਫਿਕਾਨੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh pheek phikaane janam marai phir aavaigo ||5||
lines.translation: But without the Naam, they are all bland and insipid. They are born, only to die again, in the cycle of reincarnation. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਪਟਲ ਪਟਲ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਘਰੁ ਘੂਮਨਿ ਘੇਰਿ ਘੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa patal patal hai bhaaree ghar ghooman gher ghulaavaigo ||
lines.translation: The veil of Maya is a thick and heavy veil, a whirlpool which destroys one's home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨੂਰ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: paap bikaar manoor sabh bhaare bikh dutar tario na jaavaigo ||6||
lines.translation: Sins and corrupt vices are totally heavy, like rusted slag. They will not let you cross over the poisonous and treacherous world-ocean. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau bairaag bhaiaa hai bohith gur khevat sabad taraavaigo ||
lines.translation: Let the Fear of God and neutral detachment be the boat; the Guru is the Boatman, who carries us across in the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam har bheteeai har raamai naam samaavaigo ||7||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Lord, the Name of the Lord, merge in the Lord, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਜਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan laai savaaliaa gur giaanai laai jagaavaigo ||
lines.translation: Attached to ignorance, people are falling asleep; attached to the Guru's spiritual wisdom, they awaken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaanai aapanai jiu bhaavai tivai chalaavaigo ||8||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Will, He makes us walk as He pleases. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam taraavaigo ||
lines.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and be carried across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੋਈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo japai soee gat paavai jiu dhroo prahilaad samaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whoever chants and meditates on it is emancipated. Like Dhroo and Prahlaad, they merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||
